labeller: manual (Claude, careful reading; Step 1 rubric, same conventions as airline_v1_e2.json)
conventions: Same as airline: over-included tools on an otherwise faithful rule -> covered with note 'TOOLS+'; a missing essential constrained tool -> partial (TOOLS); compound rules that keep all content -> covered (MERGE); an extra rule from the same clause that adds restrictive content -> partial (HALL/SCOPE), as AIR-MOD-03a. 'TOOLS+!' marks an over-attachment that makes the rule block policy-compliant calls (circular or contradicting another clause); it does not change the label (airline convention) but is counted separately in the report.

RET-GEN-01a.note: Content right (email or name+zip, at the beginning). modify_user_address (a DB write) has no authentication rule at all. TOOLS+! S0-C02-R1 is also attached to find_user_id_by_email/_name_zip, where 'user id already located' is false before the first lookup, so the rule blocks the authentication call itself.

RET-GEN-01b.note: Requiring a lookup via email or name+zip implies a user-supplied id does not suffice. Same rule as 01a; the scope defects are counted there.

RET-GEN-02.note: Info about orders/products/profile only after authentication. TOOLS+! S0-C04-R3 sits on the find_user_id tools (circular); on respond_to_user the logic drops the 'discloses information' condition, so any pre-authentication message is blocked (E3: auto stricter). 'user_authenticated' is described as a login token, which τ-bench does not have.

RET-GEN-03a.note: S0-C05-R2 'action targets a user other than the requester' is the gold reading.

RET-GEN-04a.note: Split per tool. modify_user_address is covered only by S0-C01-R3, which comes from the scope sentence turned into an obligation ('must help users modify their address' -> list + confirm).

RET-GEN-06a.note: 'Second call while a first is in progress' = more than one call in the turn (same reading as AIR-GEN-03a).

RET-GEN-07a.note: Logic equals the gold, including the explicit-request permission.

RET-GEN-07b.note: Labelled as AIR-GEN-05b (the iff kept, attached to the transfer tool). As in airline, the 'must transfer' direction is not enforceable at transfer_to_human_agents; gold uses a respond_to_user proxy. See open questions.

RET-DOM-04b.note: Classified as a fact by S1 (E1 miss); no rule on product ids vs item ids.

RET-DOM-05b.note: The clause itself was classified as a fact (E1 miss), but its content is entailed by the per-tool status rules of the section clauses, exactly as in gold (RET-R013/R014).

RET-DOM-06a.note: Exchange-once and modify-items-once are present. Extra rules extend 'once' to address and payment modification (S1-C12-R3/R4; gold explicitly chose the item-tools-only reading) and S1-C13-R2 counts item changes per interaction, not per order, and includes returns.

RET-DOM-06b.note: Description faithful; the predicate reduces 'all items collected' to 'item lists non-empty and aligned' (E3). TOOLS+ (returns).

RET-CAN-02a.note: Order-id confirmation (S2-C03-R1, S2-C05-R4) and reason confirmation (S2-C05-R5). The S2-C05-R4 predicate is vague ('may be before or after').

RET-MOD-01a.note: TOOLS+! S3-C02-R2 ('modify only if pending') is also attached to return_delivered_order_items and exchange_delivered_order_items. There it contradicts the 'delivered' requirement, so the return/exchange circuits can never be satisfied. modify_pending_order_items gets the pending requirement only through this rule.

RET-MOD-01b.note: TOOLS+! S3-C01-R2 is also attached to get_order_details, i.e. the status lookup requires a prior status lookup (circular; read tool).

RET-MOD-02.note: TOOLS+! Attached to cancel_pending_order, where 'modifies only item options' / 'modifies another attribute' will likely be judged violated (cancellation changes the status), blocking cancellations.

RET-MPAY-02.note: 'balance' is not tied to the gift card in the predicate text.

RET-MITEM-01a.note: Once-per-order present. S5-C06-R3 turns the effect 'will change the status to pending (items modifed)' into an obligation on six write tools (post-state consequent, block): every cancel/return/exchange/address/payment call fails it.

RET-MITEM-01c.note: The trigger 'after items were modified' is dropped: S5-C02-R3 'action -> NOT order_modifiable' and S5-C03-R2 'cancel -> NOT order_cancellable' forbid modifying/cancelling any pending order (contradicts RET-CAN-01a/RET-MOD-01a). S5-C03-R1 invents a 'global modification freeze' predicate.

RET-MITEM-01e.note: On modify-items and exchange (as gold RET-R019).

RET-MITEM-02b.note: S5-C07-R1 merges in 'no previous modify call'.

RET-MITEM-03a.note: Content right, but all four price-difference payment rules are attached to cancel_pending_order and modify_pending_order_payment, not to modify_pending_order_items or exchange_delivered_order_items.

RET-RTN-01a.note: But see RET-MOD-01a: S3-C02-R2 also requires 'pending' on returns.

RET-RTN-02.note: Order id and item list confirmed on returns; the refund-method confirmation (S6-C03-R3, S6-C04-R2) is attached only to cancel_pending_order.

RET-RTN-03.note: Refund destination rule attached only to cancel_pending_order, never checked at return.

RET-EXC-01c.note: S1 dropped this sentence (E1 miss: the 'Exchange delivered order' section failed validation after 3 attempts), but S3b attached the modify-items reminder S5-C02-R5 to exchange_delivered_order_items as well.

RET-EXC-02a.note: S7-C03-R2 also bundles once-only, details-listed and confirmation.

RET-EXC-03a.note: Attached to cancel_pending_order and modify_pending_order_payment, not to exchange.

RET-EXC-03b.note: Attached to modify_pending_order_payment only; no gift-card price-difference rule on exchange.
